name: opl-flow
description: OPL Flow establishes the Codex experience baseline and coordinates durable work across tasks, repositories, and machines.

interface.longDescription: OPL Flow configures the Codex experience baseline and coordinates durable work. Installation deploys capability only; explicit $opl-flow start onboards the owner's complete Ledger, one hourly Supervisor, registered Linear projects, and fresh receipt.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $opl-flow doctor to check my Codex baseline, or $opl-flow start to onboard and supervise my complete Ledger.
